notes.content: The page continues a sentence about translating a construction into excellent schemes using étale tubular neighborhoods. It proposes a fine homotopy type for moderate spaces and excellent schemes by a limiting process over equisingular stratifications. The added parenthesis mentions an inductive limit in describing knowledge of all sheaves or n-stacks. It states a hoped-for functorial dependence on X and a formulation of strong cohomological or homotopical finiteness statements in terms of ordinary constituents that are essentially finite polyhedra, and even compact manifolds with boundary. The page ends mid-sentence after ou de façon plus précise,. These are descriptions of source assertions, not proved conclusions.

The lower stroke’s visible bowl, not the meaning of the sentence, distinguishes barred m from equality. The two P forms were each read before applying the same preferred alphabet. No theorem was proved or rechecked.
